name: Endurance Tech.
why: Record quarterly sales, annual sales, annual profit
Working capital healthy - debtor days 45 to 46, inventory days 52 to 50 (not rising)
Management outlook: SOP will start in September 2026 and we expect significant pickup in this business by Q4 FY 27.
Domestic institutions (mutual funds, insurers) raised holding by 1.4 pts in a year
Profits backed by cash: operating cash flow is 180% of 3-year profit
risks: Margins shrinking (13% to 12%) - record profit may be near peak
FIIs (foreign funds) cut holding by 1.8 pts in a year
Cost quality weak: margin shrinking or operating profit falling (costs 87% to 88% of sales)
Sector cycle: Weak / out of favour

guidance: SOP will start in September 2026 and we expect significant pickup in this business by Q4 FY 27.
Also, we are expanding our existing 4W casting operations at our Chennai plant where we have secured orders for hybrid models of Isuzu and we expect SOP in Q4 of this financial year.
capex: Earlier, we had announced a figure of 12 lakhs units per annum to our existing ABS capacity of 6.4 lakhs units per annum.
Though the government is yet to issue final g uidelines, our ABS and CBS hydraulic brake expansion is progressing as planned, with SOP expected in September or early October 2026.
risks: As we close Q1 of FY 27, the business scenario presents a mixed picture with a steady domestic economy set against a more challenging global environment.
Earlier, RBI had raised its FY 27 inflation forecast to 5.1%, citing energy prices, West Asia conflict, and monsoon uncertainty.
focus: Also, to meet increased demand from Hero MotoCorp and TVS, we are adding capacity at our Waluj brakes plant, increasing our volumes by 1 million numbers per annum.
With our focus on increasing 4W casting business at our AURIC Shendra plant at Chh.
Earlier, our FY 25 ESG score for SES and NSE had also improved year -on-year to 74.9 and 69, reflecting our Company's continued focus on ESG.
